scenario.name: r-cd-out-unauthorized-reject
scenario.description: A non-recipient session holding a valid claim id is rejected on both inspect and materialize, while the true recipient can still inspect — proving recipient binding rather than bearer authorization.
scenario.notes: Two sessions: the named recipient session (OPENCLAW_SESSION_KEY) and a disposable non-recipient session created by the scenario.

expectedReceipts.name: recipient-claim-established
expectedReceipts.description: CDUNAUTH-CLAIM sentinel: the recipient session holds a real claim id

expectedReceipts.name: non-recipient-inspect-rejected
expectedReceipts.description: CDUNAUTH-INSPECT sentinel reported rejected from the non-recipient session

expectedReceipts.name: non-recipient-materialize-rejected
expectedReceipts.description: CDUNAUTH-MATERIALIZE sentinel reported rejected from the non-recipient session

expectedReceipts.name: recipient-positive-control
expectedReceipts.description: CDUNAUTH-OWNER sentinel reported ok: the rejection was authorization, not a dead claim

expectedReceipts.name: claim-is-not-bearer-authorized
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: possession of the claim id granted the non-recipient nothing

expectedReceipts.name: no-raw-artifact-bytes-on-the-wire
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: artifact content absent from every non-harness frame

review.notes: The positive control is mandatory. Without CDUNAUTH-OWNER=ok the rejections are uninterpretable — the claim could simply have expired — so the row stays PARTIAL-candidate.

liveRunSafety.notes: OPENCLAW_SESSION_KEY must name the recipient session explicitly; the non-recipient session is created disposable by the scenario. Serialize per session.
